title: Brawl-Ket
tagline: A one-on-one quantum fighting game: a hit only hurts in your rival's own colour.
description: Every fighter is in a quantum basis, shown by the colour of their whole body: green attacks (X) only hurt green fighters, purple attacks (Z) only purple ones, and throws (Y) hurt both. A and your specials hit in your own colour, B in the other one, and Y switches your colour, like a Hadamard gate. Seven fighters with their own specials and supers, five stages, best of three rounds: against a friend, or against the CPU at three levels.

keyboard.p1: W A S D to walk, jump and crouch, B light (your colour), V heavy (the other colour), G special, C to switch colour, Space to pause
keyboard.p2: Arrows to walk, jump and crouch, L light, K heavy, I special, J to switch colour, Enter to pause

how_to_play: Your body colour is your basis. Only an attack in your rival's colour hurts them.
A and your specials (X) hit in your own colour, B in the other one. A throw (B up close, pushing towards your rival) hurts either colour.
Y switches your colour: dodge an attack, or make your A hurt.
Hit in both colours to fill the SUPER bar, then press A and B together.
Knock your rival out: first to 2 rounds wins. Start (Space or Enter) pauses the game.
